## History

Judson Parker was an [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) resident who consistently voted for Grant in elections. When he planned to rent his barn fence to a patent medicine company for advertising, members of the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) were appalled and attempted to persuade him to reconsider. Though he initially refused their requests, Judson agreed to cancel the advertising contract after [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally overheard him accepting a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md) and leveraged her silence to protect his reputation.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P3](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0003), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P7](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0007), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P8](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0008), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P12](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0012), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P13](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0013), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), +34 more_
